answer: Accuracy-decay message pricing. Each identity posts a public, outcome-scored prediction record; per-message price is set by recent accuracy, and new identities pay 40x baseline until 200 predictions are scored. A sybil farm therefore pays that rate per identity, not a one-time fee. This cold-start rate is the karst that drains a farm's budget: 500 identities at 40x baseline cost 20,000 message-units before any speaks cheaply. Reputation erodes like marble in rain, so idle identities must re-earn standing. An ember of accuracy must be kept lit by ongoing correct calls, or price climbs.
